title: Block child/helper approval decisions and execution of high-risk server approvals
problem: A Child View session can read, approve, and reach execution for a high-risk server approval.
evidence: API probe created an sms.send approval as Owner, fetched it as Child View, approved it as child-1 with status 200, then executed with the child session. SMS was unconfigured, so execution returned not_configured rather than sending.
likelyRootCause: server/index.mjs approval decide route uses gate(req,{}) instead of an adult/admin role check; consumeApproval ignores role and decidedBy authority; approval GET is only session-gated.
recommendedFix: Require Adult Admin or Owner for approval decisions by default; add per-approval allowed approver policy; check decision role, actor scope, household, and approval status before execution; reject consumed approvals not decided by an authorized actor.
dependencies: Define approval authority model by risk/category/space; migrate existing local approvals or mark them unbound.
successCriteria: Child View and Guest/Helper receive 403 for approval decide and cannot consume approval IDs; Adult Admin/Owner can approve only approvals in allowed household/space; tests cover read, decide, changed input, consumed, expired, wrong actor, and wrong role cases.

title: Scope dashboard data by profile, role, and space before rendering
problem: Child View hides privileged navigation but still sees adult approvals, bills, sensitive document titles, and admin quick actions on the dashboard.
evidence: Child profile browser probe showed pending approvals, pay utility bill, recent files including subscription and repair documents, Connect/New automation quick actions, and adult household summaries.
likelyRootCause: screenAllowedForRole is screen-level only; Dashboard derives briefing, pendingApprovals, overdue, files, threads, and suggestions from unfiltered AppData.
recommendedFix: Introduce a server-backed authorization/filter layer for AppData by member role, member id, space membership, sensitivity, and category. Hide or disable quick actions based on role. Treat frontend filtering as presentation only; backend APIs must enforce the same boundaries.
dependencies: Define household role policy, child/guest allowed spaces, sensitivity labels, and who can see approvals.
successCriteria: Child View sees only child-appropriate events/tasks/files and no adult bills/approvals; quick actions that require adult role are hidden or explain access; backend API returns filtered data or refuses restricted reads.

title: Stop treating seed/local approvals as real external action approvals
problem: Seeded approvals without backendApprovalId/toolId can be approved in the UI and mark related messages as Sent/runs as Completed without executing any connector.
evidence: src/data/seed.ts creates pending approvals such as ap-school-email with no backendApprovalId. src/store/useStore.ts approveRequest marks messages Sent and runs Completed when no backend execution is pending.
likelyRootCause: Local demonstration approvals share the same UI status semantics as server-bound real approvals.
recommendedFix: Split approval types into draft_review, simulated_seed, and executable_server_approval. Only executable approvals can use external-send language. For seeded examples, show 'sample approval' and do not mark messages Sent.
dependencies: Approval schema migration and UI copy pass.
successCriteria: Approving unbound sample approvals never says sent/executed; executable approvals always require backendApprovalId, toolId, input hash, and server execution result.

title: Build a real HomeOps assistant runtime instead of opening an empty command palette
problem: The dashboard ask box does not answer broad family/personal requests. It only handles local regex cases for agent/reminder and otherwise opens an empty command palette.
evidence: Browser probe entered 'Summarize today's family schedule and tell me what needs attention.' The app opened Quick actions with no carried query, answer, plan, or trace.
likelyRootCause: Dashboard runAsk is a thin local command router; CommandBar is search/create action UI, not a conversational assistant surface.
recommendedFix: Create an assistant thread runtime that accepts natural language, retrieves allowed household context, plans tools/connectors/approvals, streams an answer, writes an execution trace, and links generated tasks/workflows/approvals.
dependencies: Authorization-filtered context API, tool catalog, provider selection, trace schema, approval policy.
successCriteria: Representative tasks return a grounded answer or blocked plan with required connectors/approvals; every response has trace, sources, status, and next action.

title: Replace local automation-run simulation with a durable execution engine
problem: UI automation runs complete instantly as local records without proving connector calls, retries, branching, or stateful multi-step execution.
evidence: Running Morning Family Briefing produced 'Family Briefing Agent · Test · Schedule ... Completed' with in-app summary. src/lib/runtime.ts creates completed run/subagent records in local AppData.
likelyRootCause: Current executeAgentRun is a local state mutation layer, separate from backend jobs/tools.
recommendedFix: Introduce backend workflow runs with step state, tool calls, retries, wait states, approval pauses, resumption, cancellation, and audit log correlation. Frontend should display server run state.
dependencies: Tool execution contracts, approval tokens, job queue/storage, trace model.
successCriteria: A workflow run executes actual read tools where configured, pauses for missing connectors/approvals, resumes after approval, and survives refresh/restart.

title: Implement Skill Evolution Engine and Agent Evolution Engine
problem: HomeOps has memories, playbooks, agent configs, and subagent run records, but no dual evolution engines, no utility-scored skills, no feedback-driven agent updates, and no synchronized skill/agent state.
evidence: Repo search found no evolution engine, utility/Q-value model, skill registry, reward feedback, or agent effectiveness model. Existing memory is CRUD/local display.
likelyRootCause: Product models are presentational and seed-driven; runtime learning was not implemented.
recommendedFix: Add versioned Skill, SkillVersion, AgentVersion, ExecutionTrace, FeedbackEvent, SkillUtility, AgentEvaluation, and EvolutionDecision models. Use similarity recall plus utility scoring; require human review for promoted skills/agent updates.
dependencies: Execution trace durability, feedback capture, memory privacy scopes, review/approval workflow.
successCriteria: Successful/failed runs produce candidate skill updates and agent improvement proposals with evidence; approved skills become available to eligible agents; low-utility skills can be retired.

title: Make child/guest backend reads least-privilege, not just writes
problem: Backend routes such as connectors/providers/accounts are session-gated but not role-scoped; child sessions can retrieve connector/provider catalogs and server approvals by id.
evidence: Child approval GET returned full high-risk approval preview. Code uses gate(req,{requireSession:true}) for approval GET and connectors/providers reads.
likelyRootCause: Role model is applied to only a subset of routes and not to data filtering.
recommendedFix: Add route-level read policies and object-level scope checks. For children/guests, restrict provider catalogs, approvals, audit-like events, files, and sensitive spaces.
dependencies: Role-policy matrix and object ownership/sensitivity metadata.
successCriteria: Child/guest API tests cannot read adult connector setup, high-risk approval details, medical/financial files, or audit records.

title: Correct provider/local AI readiness semantics
problem: Settings shows Ollama and LM Studio as Configured because they have default base URLs, while live health probes report unreachable.
evidence: API health probes: ollama and lmstudio status unreachable; Settings body showed both as Configured.
likelyRootCause: Readiness conflates configured defaults with actual reachable provider health.
recommendedFix: Separate configured, reachable, active, model-selected, and usable states. Default local URLs should be 'available to configure' until health/model discovery succeeds.
dependencies: Provider status vocabulary and UI badge updates.
successCriteria: Unreachable local providers are shown as Not running/Unreachable, cannot be selected as active without a reachable health check and model.

title: Improve planner grounding against connected accounts and internal HomeOps data
problem: The planner generated a weekly briefing plan using Google and Todoist even though neither account is connected, and it did not use existing internal chores/tasks as first-class sources.
evidence: API /api/agent/plan returned requiredConnectors Google and Todoist with connected:false and missing list, while the app already has local tasks/chores/events.
likelyRootCause: Planner catalog is dominated by connector/provider tools and lacks a first-class internal HomeOps data/tool surface.
recommendedFix: Expose internal read/write tools for household tasks, events, files, memories, approvals, and playbooks. Rank connected/local tools before unavailable external tools unless the request explicitly requires the external app.
dependencies: Internal tool manifests and authorization-filtered data API.
successCriteria: For family briefing, the planner uses local events/tasks/files plus connected tools when available, clearly blocks only missing external pieces.

title: Make connector cards fully accessible and keyboard-operable
problem: Household utility connector cards are clickable role=button divs without specific aria-labels; several automation buttons are icon-only or repeated generic 'Run'.
evidence: Browser DOM showed utility cards as role=button with null aria labels and long computed names. Automations screen exposed repeated blank buttons and repeated Run controls.
likelyRootCause: Card component is used as a clickable div instead of a native button/link with semantic labels.
recommendedFix: Use native button/link elements or add aria-label, tabIndex, keyboard handlers, and clear names. Label icon buttons and scope repeated Run controls with workflow name.
successCriteria: Keyboard-only and screen-reader tests can open every connector and identify each Run/Edit control by unique name.

title: Require secure owner/admin onboarding before elevated profile use
problem: Elevated profiles show 'may need PIN' but Owner login succeeded without a PIN because no owner PIN is set.
evidence: Profile gate showed Owner may need PIN; API/UI Owner login succeeded with ownerPinSet:false.
likelyRootCause: Owner PIN is optional and not enforced as a first-run setup requirement.
recommendedFix: During first-run onboarding, require owner/admin PIN or passkey before enabling elevated profiles. Make 'PIN required' copy truthful.
dependencies: First-run flow and account recovery policy.
successCriteria: Fresh install requires elevated-profile protection before connector/config/approval capability is enabled.

title: Clarify browser automation as unavailable until runtime is connected
problem: Browser Automation is honestly marked runtime_unavailable, but seeded workflows and activity still imply browser monitor/download/cancellation behavior occurred.
evidence: API /api/browser/session returned runtime_unavailable. Seeded automations include camp monitor failure, personal records filing, and cancellation approvals.
likelyRootCause: Sample workflows are not visually separated from actual runtime capability.
recommendedFix: Label browser-runtime dependent examples as sample/not runnable until runtime is connected; block run buttons with setup CTA.
dependencies: Connector readiness propagation into workflow templates/runs.
successCriteria: No workflow implies browser action execution unless BROWSER_RUNTIME_URL health is reachable.

title: Address Vite 8/Rolldown build deprecation warnings
problem: Production build passes but emits Vite/Rolldown deprecation warnings about esbuild and optimizeDeps.rollupOptions.
evidence: npm run build passed with warnings recommending plugin-react-oxc and optimizeDeps.rolldownOptions.
likelyRootCause: Current Vite/plugin configuration uses deprecated keys in Vite 8.
recommendedFix: Update Vite React plugin/config to supported Vite 8 options and verify build remains stable.
successCriteria: npm run build produces no deprecation warnings.
